quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 19.026 billion, up 50.05% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 3.287 billion (+130.42%). Copper-clad laminate and prepreg revenue RMB 12.357 billion (+47.74%, gross margin 29.16%); PCB revenue RMB 5.519 billion (+52.03%, gross margin 31.20%). The company attributed revenue growth to CCL volume and mix improvement and higher PCB volume and high-value-added share.

quarterly_data.signal: Volumes in H1 2026: CCL output +18.83% and CCL sales +14.24% YoY; prepreg output +9.08% and sales +12.43%; PCB output +24.73% and sales +23.07%. Jiangxi Shengyi CCL sales rose 95.15% and its revenue 160.87%; subsidiary Shengyi Electronics (PCB) revenue rose 53.46%.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: in H1 2026 it seized explosive AI compute demand, deepening collaboration with leading domestic and overseas AI server, data-center and compute-chip customers, while smart-driving and storage markets also progressed; the share of high-end products rose significantly. With upstream raw materials rising sharply, supply short of demand and industry capacity tight, it adjusted its product pricing strategy while balancing customer relationships and cost pressure; senior management visited core upstream suppliers to secure supply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company cites Prismark: Shengyi's rigid CCL sales ranked No. 2 globally every year from 2013 to 2025, with a 13.2% global market share in 2025. It says it has developed a full series of high-speed products across dielectric-loss grades and multiple high-frequency products in volume use.
